nonBlockingObservations.title: Qualify or supersede the retained r11 settlement cases
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The retained r11 cases still promise known elapsed for unavailable macOS and describe ECHILD settlement without a Linux qualifier. The operative r12/r13 rules override those macOS conclusions. Restrict the old cases to Linux or mark the macOS branch superseded. This is the existing r12 observation, not a new r13 error.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Attribute the OS-dependent rejection to the validator
nonBlockingObservations.observation: The retained case still attributes macOS within rejection to JSON Schema, which has no OS-dependent complete-row condition. The mandatory platform reason is enforced by the semantic validator. Move that case under the validator heading; the schema correctly rejects the informational field on a complete row. This is the existing r12 observation.

priorFindingAssessment.assessment: DESIGN:891-896 defines informational timing through actual creation, observed reaping and valid monotonic timestamps. A failed launch or unreaped root now carries run-failed and null timing; a failed run whose root was reaped can keep its known value. ENV:5 mirrors this correction. DESIGN:918 and :1085/:1089-1090 add calibration and reference cases covering availability and the original failed-before-root counterexample.

requestAssessment.changesElsewhere: Only revision title/history and the response table accompany the declared availability rule, one calibration case and three reference cases.

scopeAssessment: The full DESIGN/schema delta is confined to the requested correction and revision metadata. The schema's only change is its description; structural definitions, reasons, carriers, QD-27 performance nulling, aggregates, budgets and Linux settlement are unchanged. Acceptance is for these exact r13 design subjects, not implementation or qualification evidence.

verification.method: Static full DESIGN/schema comparison, current/retained hashes and sizes, schema structure/reference inspection, failed-slot and informational-availability review, and independent review slices.
